headline:
Two Services.
One Goal: More Revenue.
intro: Whether you need a clear strategic roadmap or a full ongoing CRO partnership, we have a model built for your stage.

service_1.label: Service 01
service_1.title: Revenue Leak Diagnostic
service_1.description: A dollar-sized map of where your store loses profit per session — and exactly what to test first.

items.text: Funnel model from your GA4 + Shopify data

service_1.sample_finding: Checkout abandonment at 78% — primary CTA above the fold is competing with 3 other CTAs.

service_2.title: CRO & A/B Testing for D2C Shopify & Shopify Plus Brands
service_2.description: A fully managed, data-driven CRO programme for D2C Shopify and Shopify Plus brands. We research, design, run, and analyse experiments every month — you see the lift in conversion rate, AOV and revenue per visitor.
